title: calamagrostis stricta subsp. groenlandica
intro: Calamagrostis stricta subsp. groenlandica, commonly known as Arctic Brome or Northern Fescue, is a subspecies of grass native to the Arctic regions. It is known to have various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of Calamagrostis stricta subsp. groenlandica include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
